cases.title: YCB external false presence
cases.direct_visual_review: YCB source target projection contains an externally hidden vertical stripe at the query; selected SAM mask fills the crop and yields logit17.733. It cannot certify target ownership in that region.

cases.title: YCB visible false absence
cases.direct_visual_review: YCB visible-source false absence lies at a rendered visible-mask boundary; SAM contour passes below the exact query. This example is compatible with small contour displacement, not evidence that the entire target is absent.

cases.title: SYNTH visible false absence
cases.direct_visual_review: Synthetic visible-source false absence is a pallet silhouette corner: query is on the green GT edge, SAM contour retreats by a few native pixels. The raw crop shows the pallet/ground boundary.

cases.title: SYNTH external correct absence
cases.direct_visual_review: Synthetic external-source true absence has the query on an occluding crate. SAM leaves that interior region outside its foreground mask; it correctly retains much of the neighboring pallet support.

scope: Actual source RGB/crops and masks directly viewed after inference seal. Qualitative examples; no model/prompt/threshold selection or private evaluation.
